name: computer_use_ootb
test_cmd:
mkdir -p "$ENV/home" "$ENV/tmp" && HOME="$ENV/home" TMPDIR="$ENV/tmp" PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX="$ENV/tmp/pycache" PYTHONPATH=. OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-dummy ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-dummy QWEN_API_KEY=dummy GRADIO_ANALYTICS_ENABLED=False HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 $PY -c 'import sys, time, importlib, compileall
t = time.time()
res = []
ok = [bool(compileall.compile_dir(d, quiet=1, force=True)) for d in ("computer_use_demo", "install_tools")] + [bool(compileall.compile_file("app.py", quiet=1, force=True))]
res.append(("compileall computer_use_demo install_tools app.py", all(ok)))
for m in ("computer_use_demo.gui_agent.llm_utils.oai", "computer_use_demo.gui_agent.llm_utils.qwen", "computer_use_demo.gui_agent.planner.anthropic_agent", "computer_use_demo.gui_agent.actor.uitars_agent", "computer_use_demo.gui_agent.planner.api_vlm_planner", "computer_use_demo.loop"):
    try:
        importlib.import_module(m)
        res.append(("import " + m, True))
    except BaseException as e:
        print("ERROR importing", m, "->", type(e).__name__, e)
        res.append(("import " + m, False))
for name, good in res:
    print(("PASSED " if good else "FAILED ") + name)
p = sum(1 for _, g in res if g); f = len(res) - p
print(("%d failed, " % f if f else "") + "%d passed in %.2fs" % (p, time.time() - t))
sys.exit(1 if f else 0)'
notes: No test suite in the repo (no tests/, no CI config; requirements.txt lists pytest but nothing uses it), so test_cmd is the v3 SMOKE check. It is one $PY -c script that counts 7 checks and prints a pytest-style summary ('7 passed in Xs', or 'N failed, M passed in Xs' with exit 1) that parse_counts reads. Check 1: compileall (force=True) over computer_use_demo/, install_tools/ and app.py, so any syntax error anywhere in the repo fails it. Checks 2-7: importlib.import_module of each production module with an LLM call plus their callers: computer_use_demo.gui_agent.llm_utils.oai (raw requests.post to api.openai.com and to the self-hosted ssh Qwen server), computer_use_demo.gui_agent.llm_utils.qwen (dashscope), computer_use_demo.gui_agent.planner.anthropic_agent (anthropic client.beta.messages), computer_use_demo.gui_agent.actor.uitars_agent (openai chat.completions to a UI-TARS server), computer_use_demo.gui_agent.planner.api_vlm_planner (calls oai/qwen) and computer_use_demo.loop (wiring). app.py is compiled but not imported: importing it builds the Gradio UI, queries monitors and calls demo.launch(). local_vlm_planner / showui_agent / remote_inference run local transformers models and have no API calls, so they are compiled but not imported. Dummy keys (OPENAI_API_KEY/ANTHROPIC_API_KEY/QWEN_API_KEY) are set in test_cmd and test_env; no client is built at import time and nothing is called. Not a pip package (no setup.py/pyproject), so there is no editable install: reinstall is empty and test_cmd uses PYTHONPATH=. with cwd = the repo copy. PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=$ENV/tmp/pycache keeps .pyc files out of the working copy; HOME/TMPDIR are sandboxed into $ENV. Python 3.12.15 (README requires >= 3.12; the code uses enum.StrEnum). Setup installs requirements.txt unchanged with --exclude-newer 2026-10-13T00:00:00Z, which resolves anthropic 1.13.0, openai 3.29.0, dashscope 1.27.7, gradio 6.30.0, torch 2.14.1 (via accelerate), transformers 5.19.0, pyautogui 0.9.54 + pyobjc-framework-quartz 12.2.2 (the repo imports Quartz at module level on macOS). 137 packages. Rebuilding from scratch into a second env gave an identical uv pip freeze. Baseline runs used macOS sandbox-exec with outbound network denied (loopback allowed): 7 passed, exit 0, every time (wall 5.6s cold, 4.5s warm, 11.0s in the fresh check env). Negative check: in a scratch copy with a broken `from openai import ...` in uitars_agent.py plus a syntax error in install_tools/, it reported '2 failed, 5 passed' with exit 1. Nothing deselected.
